CustomField.description: Base start-of-day time used to derive PlannedVisitStartTime on CTR-generated Visits. Slot = this time + ((Sequence__c - 1) * 30 minutes). Stored as HH:mm in 24-hour format (e.g. 08:00, 09:30) because Custom Metadata Types do not support a native Time data type. Parsed by EUSFA_VisitGenerationService.getRouteDayStartTime and interpreted in the running user's locale to stay consistent with the existing audit-survey timing pattern.
CustomField.label: Route Day Start Time
